description: This file implements event handling and monitoring for NetworkManager on GNOME, including device state changes, IP address updates, WiFi scan results, and interface status, with callbacks and signal management.

classes.name: GnomeNetworkManagerEvents
classes.description: Handles GNOME NetworkManager events, including device state changes, IP address updates, WiFi scans, and interface status, with signal management and callbacks.

methods.name: startNetworkMangerEventMonitor
methods.description: Starts the network manager event monitoring thread and initializes signal handlers.

methods.name: stopNetworkMangerEventMonitor
methods.description: Stops the network manager event monitoring thread and cleans up signal handlers.

methods.name: cleanupSignalHandlers
methods.description: Disconnects all signal handlers to prevent resource leaks.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of GnomeNetworkManagerEvents.

methods.name: GnomeNetworkManagerEvents
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the network manager client and main loop.

methods.name: onActiveInterfaceChangeCb
methods.description: Callback for active interface change events.

methods.name: onInterfaceStateChangeCb
methods.description: Callback for interface state change events.

methods.name: onWIFIStateChanged
methods.description: Callback for WiFi state change events.

methods.name: onAddressChangeCb
methods.description: Callback for IP address changes, handles IPv4 and IPv6 address updates and loss.

methods.name: apToJsonObject
methods.description: Converts a network access point to a JSON object with SSID, security, strength, and frequency.

methods.name: onAvailableSSIDsCb
methods.description: Callback for available WiFi SSIDs scan results.
